question: Which among the following planets is also known as "morning star"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Venus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Venus** is also known as the morning star because** it appears in the east just before sunrise**.
 
• Venus is the second planet from the sun and is the brightest object in the night sky after the moon.
